page: Google Cloud Platform c4a-highmem-32-lssd is a memory-optimized server instance built on the arm64 CPU architecture. It features 32 dedicated virtual CPUs and 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. This instance type does not include graphics processing units or local storage, relying instead on network-attached storage options for persistent data. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures that the 32 arm64 cores deliver consistent execution performance without resource contention from co-located tenants.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the arm64 architecture provides a highly efficient performance-per-watt ratio, translating to a favorable resource-to-cost profile for memory-intensive workloads. The high memory-to-vCPU ratio makes this server type suitable for memory-bound applications that do not require massive parallel compute power but demand significant memory footprints. Appropriate workloads for this configuration include medium-sized relational databases, in-memory caching layers, enterprise application servers, and data analytics pipelines that process large datasets within system memory.
